name: Toomey’s Tavern
reviewNotes:
Added automatically from I Love Babylon events. Check the name and address; research the dance floor.

Directory research 2026-10-04: Full name on the site is 'Toomey's Tavern On The Crik'. Phone is from Google Maps (the website shows none). No email published (inquiries via a form). No logo on the site (only a generic favicon); Facebook/Instagram profile images need a login. Outdoor waterfront venue: live music is seasonal (spring to mid-October) and we found no mention of a dance floor. In fall the calendar shows Friday slots as 'TBD'.
hours: Sun-Thu 12 PM-12 AM; Fri-Sat 12 PM-1 AM
description: A waterfront bar and restaurant on the canal off South Ketcham Avenue in Amityville, with a large outdoor patio and tiki bar beside the boat docks. Local cover bands play on weekend afternoons from spring through early fall.

photos.alt: The front of Toomey's Tavern with a palm plant, string lights and neon beer signs under a pink and orange sunset sky
Aerial view of Toomey's outdoor patio with colorful umbrellas, picnic tables, a thatched tiki bar and boats docked alongside

evidence.note: Bar's own site: 'Toomey's Tavern On The Crik', 251 S. Ketcham Ave, Amityville NY 11701; family-run since 1954, reachable by car or boat; open Sun-Thu 12 PM-12 AM and Fri-Sat 12 PM-1 AM; links to its Facebook and Instagram.
Live music calendar lists bands on Saturday and Sunday afternoons (about 3:30-7:30 PM) through Oct 11, 2026, e.g. Redneck Romance, Victims of Rock, Music Express.
